name: Image Scaling Calculator
description: Calculate proportional image dimensions when scaling by percentage or target width.
search_intent: Scale image dimensions while preserving the original aspect ratio.
calculation: Scale factor = scalePercent / 100. Scaled width = original width × scale factor. Scaled height = original height × scale factor. Pixel area percent = scale factor² × 100.
limitations: This calculates dimensions only and does not resample an actual image.
Upscaling dimensions does not create additional source detail.
